name: ABT-418
summary: ABT-418 is a drug developed by Abbott, that has nootropic, neuroprotective and anxiolytic effects, and has been researched for treatment of both Alzheimer's disease and ADHD.

pharmacology.text: It acts as an agonist at neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, subtype-selective binding with high affinity to the α4β2, α7/5-HT3, and α2β2 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors but not α3β4 receptors ABT-418 was reasonably effective for both applications and fairly well tolerated, but produced some side effects, principally nausea, and it is unclear whether ABT-418 itself will proceed to clinical development or if another similar drug will be used instead.

uses.text: ABT-418 is a drug developed by Abbott, that has nootropic, neuroprotective and anxiolytic effects, and has been researched for treatment of both Alzheimer's disease and ADHD.

summaryZh: ABT-418是一種有機化合物，化學式為C9H14N2O，由美國雅培開發，可用作益智藥和抗焦慮藥。
summaryZhHans: ABT-418是一种有机化合物，化学式为C9H14N2O，由美国雅培开发，可用作益智药和抗焦虑药。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that act on nicotinic receptors commonly cause nausea, dizziness and headache. Its effects and risks in people have not been well established.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作用於菸鹼型受體的藥物常引起噁心、頭暈與頭痛。它在人體的作用與風險尚未充分確立。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作用于烟碱型受体的药物常引起恶心、头晕与头痛。它在人体的作用与风险尚未充分确立。

fact.en: It is built on the same framework as nicotine, with nicotine's pyridine ring replaced by an isoxazole ring, which keeps the activity while changing the chemistry.
fact.zh: 它以尼古丁的骨架為基礎，把尼古丁的吡啶環換成異惡唑環，既保留了活性，又改變了化學性質。
fact.zhHans: 它以尼古丁的骨架为基础，把尼古丁的吡啶环换成异恶唑环，既保留了活性，又改变了化学性质。
